title: A unified stochastic random walk theory for Kolmogorov spectrum, halo mass functions, and halo density profiles
task: Unify turbulent cascade, halo mass functions, and density profiles via stochastic random walk in scale space

comments: Elegant unification across scales and phenomena, but the self-consistency condition γ = 2/3 and its universality across different physical systems deserve deeper justification beyond Fokker–Planck mechanics.
